pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with high edge angularity and sharp pixel gradients between dark and light regions. Spatial area of patches is heterogeneous across the visible mid-section.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light-colored pathways with clear trifurcation and tetrafurcation nodes. Pixel thickness of corridors is narrow and relatively uniform across the visible topology.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine, bristly mane profile showing high-frequency serrations with low vertical amplitude along the dorsal neck-shoulder transition against a blurred background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent horizontal cutaneous indentation on the mid-right flank, creating a localized shadow and textural disruption across two adjacent patches.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of yellow-billed oxpeckers (Buphagus africanus) perched on the dorsal ridge and lower neck region.
